Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak Naat
Khuda Ka Mukhtasir Lashkar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Magar Bhari Hai Lakhon Par Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Maza Aa Jaye Ga Madh-e-Abu Talib Sunanay Ka
Milein Gay Qabar Ke Andar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Nuseri Kis Ko Kis Ko Apna Rab Manay Ga Tu Aakhir
Nazar Aate Hain Sab Haider Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Falanay Se Falanay Tak Sabhi Rehbar Tumhare Hain
Hamarey Muntahib Rehbar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Dar-e-Khatoon-e-Janat Teri Azmat Kibriya Jane
Kharey Hain Sab Jhukaye Sar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Bachaya Deen Ko Hum Ne Bachaya Hum Ko Zainab Ne
Khuda Se Kehte Hain Aksar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Nabowat Hazrat-e-Aadam Ko Milna Ghair Mumkin Thi
Na Hotey Naam Jo Azbar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak
Tilawat Ho Gayi Quran Ki Mehsos Hota Hai
Faqat Ik Manqabat Parh Kar Muhammad Se Muhammad Tak

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/muhammad-se-muhammad-tak-naat.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/muhammad-se-muhammad-tak-naat.md')
_, metadata, source = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
blocks = lambda s: [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman.replace('\\n  ', '\\n')), blocks(source)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in u] == [2] + [3]*7
for i, (rb, ub) in enumerate(zip(r[1:], u[1:]), 1):
    assert rb[0] == str(i) and ub[0] == chr(0x06f0+i)
print('Verified 16 paired verse lines and seven numbered stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have an opening couplet and seven numbered stanzas. Updated the title and text direction and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “muntahib” as منتخب (“chosen”) and kept the Roman spelling as supplied.
